policy: Reuse external terms whenever they already model the concept. CILE terms are permitted only for review-specific governance or criminal-infiltration concepts not adequately represented upstream.

dependencies.name: SynthScholar SLR Ontology
dependencies.role: systematic-review workflow, review events, model/tool provenance and review-level entities

dependencies.role: Entity / Activity / Agent provenance and derivation

dependencies.name: SPAR FaBiO
dependencies.role: bibliographic expressions, publication types and manifestations

dependencies.role: grounded evidence spans and source targeting

dependencies.role: controlled concept schemes including taxonomy and exclusion reasons

dependencies.name: RIPE-O
dependencies.role: evidence, questions, assessment answers and provenance of human or automated judgements

mapping_rules: A candidate record is not a scholarly work until a curator-approved promotion creates or links a canonical paper_id.
A DOI, URL, PDF, XML page, repository copy, publisher landing page or working-paper version is never sufficient by itself to create a second ScholarlyWork.
Multiple manifestations may belong to one ScholarlyWork; identity reconciliation must preserve manifestation identifiers and provenance.
ScreeningDecision is an evidence-backed entity attributed to a human reviewer; automated systems may assist but may not become the final eligibility agent.
AccessAssessment describes a manifestation or the best-known access state. restricted requires positive closed-access evidence without conflicting public-full-text evidence.
Taxonomy, exclusion reasons and secondary collections are SKOS-like controlled schemes and must not be replaced by free-text shadow vocabularies.
